headline: Santuario De La Salle / CAZA Architects
context: How can a church serve as an anchor for a broader community? This central question drove the conceptualization of Santuario de La Salle, an inclusive religious space designed by CAZA for the De La Salle University campus in Biñan City, Philippines.
